mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium, as investors anticipate future rate hikes, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: Over a 12-month window, 20-day forward returns do not outperform a 5-day rolling average during preceding inflation spikes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly PAYEMS labor cost growth above 0.5% signals wage stickiness and inflationary pressure, which elevates equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: During periods of PAYEMS > 0.5% for ≥3 months, 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than during pre-acceleration baselines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sequential decline in both HOUST industrial production and RSAFS retail sales for two consecutive months indicates weakening aggregate demand, which precedes a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < previous month AND RSAFS < previous month
failure_condition: During confirmed demand contraction (HOUST and RSAFS both down 2% or more), 5-day forward returns are not negative in more than 70% of instances (binomial test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in monthly INDPRO manufacturing index below 100 (2017=base) accompanied by elevated UNRATE unemployment suggests supply-side weakness, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: During INDPRO < 100 and rising UNRATE regime, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances (binomial test p < 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in FEDFUNDS below 4% for four consecutive months indicates a prolonged easing cycle, which amplifies equity valuation multiples and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: During FEDFUNDS < 4% for ≥4 months, 60-day forward returns do not exceed the 5-day moving average by more than one standard deviation (z-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden jump in UNRATE above 5% in a single month signals a sharp labor market tightening, which raises policy uncertainty and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5% in the current month
failure_condition: During UNRATE > 5% single-month spikes, 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 50% of such events (binomial test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in both GDPC1 personal consumption and HOUST industrial production for two consecutive months indicate a dual-demand shock, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < previous month AND HOUST < previous month
failure_condition: During GDPC1 and HOUST double-dip declines, 5-day forward returns are not negative in more than 60% of such events (binomial test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp and persistent rise in CPIAUCSL above 4% for three consecutive months signals accelerating inflation expectations, which compresses real equity returns and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: During CPIAUCSL > 4% for ≥3 months, 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than during pre-inflation-spike baselines (t-test p > 0.05).
